描述_EN: during the years of the cultural revolution the factory produced many propaganda images based on portraits and photographs of leaders. this picture was made by the hangzhou dongfang hong ('east is red') factory, which has its roots as a factory pioneering the art of machine-woven pictures in china, using paintings and photographs. when this portrait of mao zedong apepared in newspapers, the caption read: 'day and night, our great leader chairman mao devotes his attention to domestic and international affairs'.
描述_ZN: 在文化大革命时期，工厂生产了许多基于领导人肖像和照片的宣传图片。 这幅画是由杭州东方红厂制作的，该厂是中国机织画艺术的先驱，使用绘画和照片。 这幅毛泽东的画像在报纸上出现时，标题是："日日夜夜，我们的伟大领袖毛主席关注着国内和国际事务"。
